[[File:NabooCrystalCaveInterior.jpg|200px|thumb|The Naboo Crystal Cave contained a number of crystals imbued with the Force.]]
The '''Crystal Cave''', also known simply as the '''Naboo Cave''', was a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] located on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Nestled deep within the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]], the cave was home to a number of creatures known as the [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatch]], many of which were sick. The cave was also filled with a number of [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]], some of which were [[Force crystal|imbued]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Nos'lyn]] tasked a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] with traveling to this cave, so that a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] could be found to build a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="SWG:SfaJW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Crystal Cave was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SfaJW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Crystal Cave was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
